note: The opening: Ted waits just inside, behind the shut front door; the player knocks (E); GAME_STARTED and his greeting; he opens the door; when the player steps in he walks up to the lamp room while he sends them to shovel coal. scripts/world/intro_sequence.gd reads this file.
open_note: Seconds after GAME_STARTED before the door opens: Ted's greeting (1 s pause, about 6.5 s to read) ends on 'In.', so the door swings as he says it.
